# PHPMailer

Official PHPMailer 7.1.1 (PHP 5.5+), vendored for XAMPP without Composer.
Only the SMTP delivery classes are included. Distributed under LGPL-2.1; see LICENSE.

Upstream: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/tree/v7.1.1

To update, replace src/Exception.php, src/PHPMailer.php, src/SMTP.php and LICENSE
from the same official release tag, then run the email login checks.
